items.description: Vila de Ataúro is the main settlement on Ataúro Island. It is famous for its stunning coral reefs and clear surrounding waters.
Venilale is a town known for its unique Portuguese colonial architecture, including historical bridges and school buildings.
Tutuala is located at the extreme eastern tip of Timor-Leste. It is the gateway to the protected Jaco Island and pristine beaches.
Balibo is a historically significant town near the Indonesian border. It is known for its old fort and panoramic views.
Ermera is a central town set within a major coffee-producing region. Its landscape is dominated by lush hills and agricultural plantations.
Iliomar is located in the eastern Lautém district. The area is known for its relatively untouched natural environment and traditional villages.
Luro is a small town in the Lautém district, characterized by its quiet atmosphere and scenic mountain surroundings.
Uatucarbau is situated along the southern coast of Viqueque municipality. It is a remote town defined by its proximity to the sea.
Ossu is a town in Viqueque municipality, noted for its dramatic mountain setting and surrounding limestone landscapes.
Alas is a small town located in the Manufahi municipality, south of the central mountain range.
